text:
Priya: quick async check — final QTR milestone pulse. can folks drop a one-line update: what shipped, what slipped, owner, any blockers? I need to update the roadmap doc by EOD Fri. :wave:

Connor: Shard-routing rollout — shipped (canary -> 100%). owner: Connor. minor perf regression at 99th pctl; opened bug in #eng-runtime. not blocking OKR. :thumbsup:

Maya: Model quantization experiment — slipped. was aiming for 3/15, now targeting 4/05. owner: Maya. blocker: kernel/backport issue on perf libs (needs eng-infra). added brief notes to the experiment doc.

Jordan: Eng-infra here — I can take the kernel backport. ETA 3/22 for backport + smoke tests. @Maya pls attach perf test link and I'll coordinate with infra stage.

Maya: added link: https://short.redwood/quant-q4 (experiment readme + perf cases). thanks @Jordan, will post failing case there.

Ethan: Embeddings autoscale infra — shipped last week. owner: Ethan. measured cost reduction ~18% in staging; will push metrics to dashboard tomorrow. no blockers.

Alex: CR ping to Maya — PR #4123 failing `test_kv_cache` on CI, needs rebase. can you take a pass?

Maya: on it, rebasing now and will force-push in ~15m. thx.

Connor: Heads up — Dedicated capacity SLA tweak (feature flag + billing update) merged but rollout to beta customers delayed due to security review. slip -> 3/29. owner: Priya/security. flagged sales docs dependency.

Priya: noted. dependency: Sales needs dedicated feature doc for enterprise GA. @marketing / @Kayla can you take a quick sync to get the doc ready?

Jordan: deploy-bot: Canary deployment completed for shard-routing (build 2026.03.15-231).

Priya: small actionable items for me to collate: 1) collect final ship dates (Connor, Ethan) 2) confirm kernel ETA (Jordan) 3) confirm PR status (Maya) 4) sales doc owner (Marketing). I'll compile and post an updated roadmap snapshot by 5pm PT today. if anything changes, drop a one-line update here. :spiral_calendar:

Connor: FYI I'll post a perf note to the roadmap doc after we close the runtime ticket.

Maya: PR rebased and green, pushed. moving quant experiment to blocked->in-progress after kernel backport.

Ethan: added dashboard tile; will annotate cost numbers.

Priya: thanks all — will stitch this into the roadmap and ping leadership. if you want a quick async handoff, paste any final links here.

Alex: link to CR: https://git.redwood/repo/pulls/4123 (for trace).

Priya: closing — appreciate the quick updates. :raised_hands:
